direction.description: Flow direction: TB = top→bottom (default), LR = left→right.

id.description: Stable id referenced by edges (from/to) and steps.

label.description: Node label. Empty is allowed for initial/final markers.

sub.description: Second, smaller line under the label (e.g. a qualifier or actor).

kind.description: Shape/role. workflow: start|task|decision|subprocess|wait|end; dataflow: external|process|datastore; lifecycle: initial|state|choice|final. Defaults to 'task' (workflow), 'process' (dataflow), 'state' (lifecycle).

service.description: Canonical AWS/service name to AUTO-RESOLVE a small node icon (e.g. 'AWS Lambda', 'Amazon SQS'). Same resolver as the other diagrams — call resolve_icon to confirm.

icon.description: Explicit icon reference — overrides `service`. Bare name resolves under icons/ (e.g. 'Arch_AWS-Lambda_48.png'); a prefixed path is used as-is ('tech-icons/vault.svg', 'aws-icons/user.svg').

tone.description: Static accent for the node border/fill (independent of the walkthrough).

nodes.description: Graph nodes. Kinds for dataflow: external (source/sink) · process · datastore (cylinder).

to.description: Target node id (== from draws a self-loop, e.g. a retry or a self-transition).

label.description: Edge label — a guard/branch ('[approved]', '[else]'), a data name ('order.json'), or an event ('onStart').

kind.description: flow = solid arrow (default); branch = solid (a labeled decision branch); back = a return/loop-back edge drawn dashed; async = open arrowhead (signal/event).

dashed.description: Force a dashed line regardless of kind.

tone.description: Static accent for the edge (independent of the walkthrough).

edges.description: Directed edges (from→to). Each edge IS a data flow — label it with the data that moves (e.g. 'order.json').

steps.description: Optional guided walkthrough — each beat lights up its nodes/edges and drives the narration panel. Omit for a static diagram.

id.description: Optional stable id for the step.

nodes.description: Node ids highlighted on this beat.

edges.description: Edge ids highlighted (drawn/animated) on this beat.

flow.description: Small sub-line under the title (e.g. 'Queue → Worker').

proof.description: Panel 'proof' line: free text OR a structured source ref {repo,path,ref,lines,url,text} rendered as a clickable link.

repo.description: Repository base URL (e.g. 'https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-architecture-diagram-mcp-server'). Combined with path/ref/lines to build a blob link.

ref.description: Commit SHA, tag, or branch to pin the link to (default 'main'). Pin to a commit for a truly stable reference.

lines.description: Line number, 'start-end' string, or [start,end] — appended as #L.. so the link opens on the exact lines.

url.description: Explicit link URL — overrides repo/path/ref/lines construction.

text.description: Link label (defaults to path:lines or the URL).

code.description: Optional fenced snippet under the description (whitespace preserved).

codeLabel.description: Uppercase label on the code block header (e.g. 'handler.py').

tone.description: Accent for the highlighted nodes/edges on this beat (default accent/orange).

badge.description: Semantic badge shown on the step.

autoplay.description: Start playing on load when steps exist (default false).

stepMs.description: Default ms per step when playing (default 1500).
